routeOrSurface: Native task chat / assistant-ui aw_experience_card display renderer
customerOutcome: Review a current source-linked Native card in the task conversation without trusting tool-authored prose or granting execution authority.
entryConditions: Effective action_cards_v9 admission and selected company match; renderer request schema version 1 passes strict bounded validation.
The current account must settle and an uncached original Native Experience read must succeed.
The referenced unique card, domain, resource ID and exact version must match the current fresh Native view.
exitConditions: Render text and canonical navigation from the Native current card only.
Failed, loading, stale, missing, ambiguous, foreign or mismatched cards present fixed unavailable/loading copy.

content.h1: Native current card title at its existing heading level
content.supportingCopy: Loading the current card… / This card could not be verified. Open Home or Needs You to review the current information.
displayedState: Native current summary, consequence and evidence.
Tool input/result prose, arbitrary HTML, effect controls and invented completion are never shown.

primary.label: Native current navigation label
primary.operation: Open the exact authorized Native destination; any eventual effect is separately authorized by its original owner.

secondary: Try again performs only a current private GET after a failed read.

canonicalReadDomains: Existing company-scoped Experience projection over original Native Tasks, Attention and other currently projected owners.
systemWork.canonicalWriteOperation: None. Display renderer only; no effect implementation, tool-result submission or additional store.
systemWork.authorityEffect: C0 presentation/navigation; a chat tool name, argument or result cannot grant authority.
systemWork.asyncWork: Original bounded Native projection read with no-store, account/company key, cancellation and authority epoch; no LLM call.
systemWork.receipt: Existing exact Native source resource ID/version, not a new execution or verification receipt.

states.loading: Announce loading only while the current identity/company request is pending.
states.empty: Explain an actual empty authorized result. Missing dependencies or qualified capabilities are separate unavailable states.
states.partial: Retain trustworthy available results and name unavailable dependencies or sources.
states.stale: Remove executable actions and refresh canonical state; preserved input is not evidence of current authority.
states.validation_error: Reject bounded-schema/control/prototype violations with fixed unavailable copy.
states.system_error: Fixed localized unavailable copy; failed read may retry a GET only. Raw tool/API errors and output are hidden.
states.permission_denied: Suppress retained private data and unavailable controls; do not infer additional grants from profile or navigation.
states.recovering: Re-resolve canonical state/version and the original request identity before permitting another effect. A mutation acknowledgement that crosses an account-authority check cannot advance the page; explicit reconciliation retains the original request identity.
states.success: A current Native view permits display, never certification of success beyond its original state.

navigation.back: Original task route navigation remains unchanged.
navigation.cancelOrSaveExit: No form input, persistence or writes exist in this renderer.
navigation.deepLink: Only current Native open actions; no tool-provided URL.
navigation.resume: Re-read current Native state after auth or access changes; exact old versions cannot restore stale content.

accessibility.initialFocus: Main heading or the dialog category control; keyboard focus is visible and unobscured.
accessibility.focusAfterError: Error summary or first invalid control, with a programmatically associated explanation.
accessibility.focusAfterSuccess: Canonical receipt or next-step heading; announcements do not trap focus.
accessibility.keyboardModel: Standard buttons, links, labeled text inputs and semantic single-select controls; dialog Escape/close and focus return use the native primitive.
accessibility.statusAnnouncement: Use status for pending/success and alert for material failures, without repeated routine interruption.
accessibility.targetSize: Custom frequent and primary controls target at least 44 × 44 CSS px.
accessibility.zoomReflow: Require browser/manual verification at 200% and 400% zoom and narrow mobile width; this file is not proof of conformance.
accessibility.reducedMotion: No essential animated transition or moving progress indicator.
accessibility.screenReaderNotes: One meaningful H1, persistent visible labels, named sections and logical DOM/focus order.

responsive.wide: Readable constrained content width with natural wrapping.
responsive.narrow: Reflow cards and form actions without concealing utilities or consequences.
responsive.mobile: Touch targets remain reachable; dialogs scroll within the viewport and do not obscure focus.

dataShown: Only current Native account/company-authorized text and links.
dataCollected: Bounded schema-versioned reference; no raw tool-result body.
sensitiveFields: Native titles, evidence and resource identity remain private customer data.
privacySecurity.loggingConstraints: No new logging, telemetry, HTML execution or external requests. The existing Native Experience private-log policy remains authoritative.

functional: Verify exact Native source/version, fresh current read, source changes, absence/duplicates, feature denial, current auth rechecks and both task chat adapters.
accessibility: Verify keyboard/focus/announcements and 200/400% zoom manually on the exact artifact.
securityPrivacy: Verify untrusted/prototype/accessor/control-key rejection; no tool-authored title/link/HTML/effect; current member and resource authorization stays in the Native owner.
usability: Use representative exploratory and pre-registered confirmatory journey evidence with explicit PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE; source checks are insufficient.
